recordings.expectedScript: As we reached Shorty Crater, Schmitt spotted something amazing—orange soil! Those tiny glass beads were born from ancient lunar volcanoes, around 3.7 billions of years ago!
recordings.currentReadingText: Schmitt discovered orange soil at Shorty Crater. Its volcanic glass beads preserve evidence of ancient explosive eruptions, about 3.6 billion years ago.
recordings.originalHoldReason: The package gives conflicting ages for the volcanic glass. NASA describes roughly 3.6-billion-year-old volcanic material.
